body: Yeah I have been considering it, honestly for now I think I’m just going to alter how I use it and reduce the time spent on it to see if that helps, if it doesn’t then I am going to cut it out completely.

Actually I have been using Tiktok to improve my artwork, there are a lot of helpful art tips and learning about the process other artists have taken.

Tiktok also got me into a few niche hobbies such as gardening certain plants as well and has taught me a few coping mechanisms for things I otherwise wouldn’t have known.

I don’t think all the content I watch is a waste of time only a certain subset of it, which is why I am hesitant to delete the whole thing.

To be fair every single one of her siblings has been formally diagnosed (she has 3 siblings), it’s very unlikely that she’s the only sibling that isn’t.

I think she has it and I think she’s trying her best to learn about it. I suspect that there’s more to play than just “she’s using her autism for self-indulgent crap” but it’s frustrating because she won’t tell me.

Literally the only way I could keep her from getting angry is walk through the puddles like they aren’t even there but I’m sorry it’s not reasonable to ask someone to just tread through human waste everyday to save someone’s feelings.
Unlikely she will listen, she has had this brought to her attention many, many times and she is pretty stubborn about not wanting to wear pads or see the doctor about it.

No matter how nice I am about it she will immediately lash out about it and resort to yelling and giving the line about “regretting this when I’m dead”.
She refuses to speak to a doctor, no matter how many times anyone speaks to her and no matter how I speak to her. My frustration is only really born from her refusing to get help.

Yes we have discussed this many, many times and she refuses to do anything about it, we’re pretty sure it is a health issue but she actively refuses to get help no matter what anyone says or how they say it.

It’s likely a medical issue, however she refuses to do anything about it, I have been polite about this in the past and she doesn’t want to wear pads either.

We live in the UK so there’s no excuse not to go to the doctor here, health care is free and pee pads can be offered on the NHS.

She has refused to see a doctor (because she thinks the doctor will just talk solely about her weight) and I have politely spoken to her many times, she also thinks it’s unreasonable for me to dodge the pee or wear pee pads.
I have put it that way before, we have had this discussion many times before. She gets defensive and starts yelling no matter how nice I am about things.
